lawyer: For the Appellant: Mr. B. Hossain, Deputy Attorney General, instructed by Mr. M. Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record. For the Respondent: Ex-parte.
parties:
The State: Appellant.
Versus
Ful Mia: Accused-respondent.
full_judgment: Leave was also granted to consider whether the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division acted wrongly in passing an order of acquittal on the basis of some minor and irrelevant considerations, namely, that P.W. 2 made a con-fused statement that the occurrence took place at 12-00 p.m. or 1-00 a.m.; that the non-seizure of the lantern which was hanging in the shop of P.W. 2 where the occurrence took place leads to the fact of non-recognition of the accused in the dark night; that non-examination of four wit-nesses named in the charge sheet raises adverse presumption against the prosecution under Section 114(g) of the Evidence Act; that the post-mortem report was inadmissible in evidence under Section 509A of the Code of Criminal Procedure as the requirement of law was not complied with and that there was no corroboration of the statement of P.W. 2 regarding the conversation that took place in the shop of P.W. 2 just before Ful Mia murdered deceased Abu Taher Q Abu.
